title: The Last Gravity Again
author: Theo Zhou
blurb: Sebastian Nystrom, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
